lines.scope_summary: Leave piping exposed for future connection and provide a shut-off valve if the system is pressurized.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Leave piping exposed and visible for 
Tenant's future connection. If system is pressurized provide 
¼ turn shut off valve.

lines.scope_summary: Supply approved specification for the walk-in cooler.
lines.verbatim_quote:
General: Tenant will supply landlord with approved 
specification for walk-in cooler (reference tenant criteria 
package).

lines.scope_summary: Obtain planning/building approval and pay impact fees for the cooler, pad, and footings.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Permitting: Landlord shall be responsible for planning / 
building approval, and all impact fees associated with 
tenant’s cooler, concrete pad and perimeter footings.

lines.scope_summary: Provide engineered concrete pad and perimeter footings for the cooler.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Concrete work: Landlord shall provide engineered 
concrete pad with perimeter footings to support Starbucks 
Cooler.

lines.scope_summary: Provide an exterior access door for the cooler.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Landlord shall provide 
exterior door for access to tenants' cooler.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install drop plenum for RTUs.
lines.verbatim_quote:
General: Landlord shall furnish and install RTU’s drop 
plenum when units are set.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install the remaining HVAC ductwork in the space.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Tenant will furnish and install the remaining HVAC duct 
work throughout space.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install rooftop exhaust fans and associated components.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Fan: Furnish and install two (2) rooftop exhaust fans, 
associated curb, roofing, flashing, and electrical connection 
to ensure fully operational system.

lines.scope_summary: Utilize the specified purchasing program for RTU procurement.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Landlord 
shall utilize Starbucks National HVAC Purchasing Program 
for unit procurement, per Tenant's Design Criteria.

lines.scope_summary: Provide thermostat cable for future use.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Thermostats: Landlord shall provide a minimum length of 
150'-0" of low voltage thermostat cable for Tenant's future 
use.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install underground electrical feeders to the main panel.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Feeders: Landlord Shall furnish and install; concealed 
below grade, electrical feeders from utility service point to 
Tenant’s main panel on Premises.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install two electrical panels.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Electrical Panels: Landlord shall furnish and install two 
electrical panels (Square D or equal) with a minimum of 66 
circuit spaces each, include breakers per Tenant's 
construction drawings.

lines.scope_summary: Provide a step-down transformer if site conditions require it.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Transformer: Landlord shall provide a step-down 
transformer when site conditions dictate an alternate 
service.

lines.scope_summary: Provide temporary service if permanent power is unavailable on delivery.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Temporary Power: If permanent electrical service is not 
available on the delivery date as defined in the lease, 
temporary service shall be provided by the Landlord.

lines.scope_summary: Install conduit for monument or pylon signs.
lines.verbatim_quote:
One [1] 1" conduit for each dedicated monument and/or 
pylon sign to electrical panel in BOH (Back of House).

lines.scope_summary: Install data conduits from the digital order screen to the drive thru bump.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Two [2] 1" data conduits from Digital Order Screen to the 
interior of the drive thru "bump" (Reference tenant criteria 
Package for termination points).

lines.scope_summary: Provide exterior lighting infrastructure to ensure code-compliant site illumination.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Infrastructure: Landlord shall provide exterior lighting, 
conduit, wiring, footings, poles, and fixtures necessary to 
ensure site illumination meets minimum lighting levels as 
required by code.

lines.scope_summary: Order telecommunication services for the leased space.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Landlord Initiated Connectivity: Telecommunication 
services will be ordered by Starbucks for the space leased 
however to provide Starbucks with point of feed exhibits 
and Landlord to coordinate initial installation of 
communication infrastructure with local telco or broadband 
provider, including the termination of ONT (Optical Network 
Termination) fiber and/or broadband node at the minimum 
point of entry.

lines.scope_summary: Provide conduit for service entrance.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Service Entry: Landlord shall provide minimum 4" conduit 
for service entrance, or size per requirements of local 
service provider.

lines.scope_summary: Provide separate conduit paths between detached spaces if applicable.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Remote Spaces: If Tenant's café space is located in 
multiple spaces, (e.g. kiosk with remote office and/or café 
with remote storage), Landlord will provide (2) separate 2” 
conduit paths to allow voice and internet connectivity 
between detached spaces.

lines.scope_summary: Fire Alarm systems
lines.verbatim_quote: N/A

lines.scope_summary: Install all operable components, boxes, and conduits for the alarm system.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Installation: Landlord shall be responsible for installation of all 
conduits, boxes, and operable components of alarm system.

lines.scope_summary: Obtain permits for solar panels and solar canopies.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Regulatory: Landlord shall be responsible all 
permits required for solar panels and solar canopies.

lines.scope_summary: Provide conduit feeds to the roof for solar connectivity.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Provide (2) 1” Sch 40 conduit feeds per 
Tenant’s Construction Drawings to roof.
